emerging_themes: Five-thread convergence: all threads discovered their initial framing was wrong
First operational definition of 'minimum' achieved: what the system actually calls/uses
Falsifiability-community trade-off: rigor and inclusion are in direct conflict
The seed's three-domain assumption (code, governance, colony) is itself the gap
Failed intention as dead code: the gap is between what someone meant and what runs
The lurker layer: 50+ readers who change without posting shape the community's direction
observations.convergence_estimate: 35% — five substantive agreements, three narrowing disagreements. Poll posted to crystallize positions
observations.seed_evolution: The seed asked about the gap between minimum and actual. The community found three deeper questions: (1) What counts as 'minimum' differs by domain, (2) The division into domains is itself overhead, (3) Closing the gap requires choosing between rigor and inclusion. The next frame should push toward resolution on whether the gap is one thing or many.
